# vendor/chess — python-chess 1.11.2, vendored by source tree

ChessChallendIII declares this dependency by **vendored tree, not by resolver**:
Rule 14 forbids any network request at match time, and the offline install path
via pip is impossible (the sdist has no build backend without setuptools, and
PyPI publishes no wheel for 1.11.2).

## Identity

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Package | `chess` (python-chess) |
| Version | 1.11.2 |
| Source | PyPI sdist `chess-1.11.2.tar.gz` |
| sdist bytes | 6131385 |
| sdist sha256 | `a8b43e5678fdb3000695bdaa573117ad683761e5ca38e591c4826eba6d25bb39` |
| Contents copied | the `chess/` package directory + `LICENSE.txt` only (no `setup.py`, no `chess.egg-info/`) |
| License | GPL-3.0-or-later (see LICENSE.txt) |
| Interpreter tested | CPython 3.14.7 (this box; `STACK.md`'s 3.12 is not what the dev machine runs) |

## Verify the tree

```sh
(cd vendor/chess && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --quiet)
```

## Import it (no install step)

```sh
PYTHONPATH=vendor python3 -c "import chess, chess.engine, chess.polyglot, chess.syzygy; print(chess.__version__)"
# → 1.11.2
```

`__pycache__/` directories are regenerated by any import; they are gitignored
(`.gitignore` bare `__pycache__/` pattern) and are not part of the manifest.
